decisions.statement: Saving time runs from the second Sunday in March to the first Sunday in November.
Saving time turns at two o'clock in the morning on the wall.
A zone further west therefore turns later in UTC.
Denver turns two hours after New York.
Spring is read against the winter offset of the zone being asked about.
Autumn is read against the winter offset less the hour saving time added.
The rule as the rule is today is applied to every year.
These offsets are judged against the zone database.

definition: how far behind UTC New York and Denver are at one instant
